content.short: AirdropScan provides a cross-chain Airdrop Checker and Project Tracker.
content.description: AirdropScan helps you check wallets for unclaimed airdrops and set up alerts so you never miss a claim again. By monitoring activity across multiple blockchain networks, it lets you track your airdrop farming progress, discover new opportunities, and stay ahead of early distribution events. Whether you are researching opportunities on Ethereum, Solana, Base, Polygon, OP Mainnet, Arbitrum, BNB Chain, ZKsync, Bitcoin, or Avalanche, AirdropScan consolidates alerts and project discoveries in one convenient platform, empowering proactive participation in the space.
content.meta: AirdropScan lets users check wallets for unclaimed airdrops and set up alerts to never miss a claim. Discover AirdropScan and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
